sentences.text: The Crime and Misconduct Commission compared Queensland laws on political donations and gifts with Australian and overseas jurisdictions.
sentences.support: This report examines political donation legislation to map Queensland’s state and local government regulatory frameworks

sentences.text: It examined donation restrictions, disclosure rules and the enforcement of state and local government requirements.
sentences.support: disclosure of political donations • compliance and enforcement mechanisms.

sentences.text: The CMC found that Queensland state disclosure obligations were generally comparable to or stricter than elsewhere, with weaker regulation of special reporting for large gifts.
sentences.support: Queensland imposes disclosure obligations on participants in the political process that are generally similar to or stricter than most other jurisdictions.

sentences.text: For local government, it found that Queensland took considerably longer than other jurisdictions to release disclosure returns publicly.
sentences.support: disclosure returns in Queensland take a much longer time to be made available to the public

sentences.text: The CMC made no recommendations, intending the comparison to inform debate and policy decisions.
sentences.support: We have not made recommendations. We anticipate that the report will inform public debate

findings.quote: Queensland’s electoral donation caps are among the lowest of all comparable jurisdictions, and therefore provide the most regulation of electoral donations.
